'''Olfactory sensors''' provided [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with a sense of smell. [[COO-series cook droid/Legends|COO cook droids]] used the sensors to determine the freshness of ingredients.<ref name="NEGTD" /> [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droids]] were also equipped with olfactory sensors.<ref name="SWTJ1">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Planet Tatooine]]''</ref> Olfactory sensors were part of the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] of a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
